summary: Feed s098_single to IDS is degraded: 92.3% of bytes are encrypted vs 60% tolerance for this IDS. All other visibility checks (duplicates, one-way, VLAN, drops, overload, truncation, tunnels, oversize) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: 92.3% of traffic by bytes is TLS/encrypted (threshold 60% for this IDS). Packet broker is forwarding encrypted sessions without decryption, so payload is opaque.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS requires full cleartext payload for signature and anomaly detection. With >92% encrypted, IDS is blind to most attacks and detection coverage is severely reduced; only metadata/handshake visible.

params.approach: SSL/TLS visibility appliance or broker-integrated decryption
params.policy: decrypt authorized traffic and forward cleartext copy to IDS, retain encrypted copy per policy

recommended_fix.why: Decrypting authorized sessions upstream restores payload visibility the IDS needs, bringing encrypted share below 60% and re-enabling signature matching without changing TAP/SPAN.
